messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: upper-bound obstruction via oriented matroid or hypergraph Turán

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "Any configuration of 13 points in the unit square must contain a triangle of area at most 1/72, because the associated 3-uniform hypergraph of small-area triples on any such configuration must contain a member of the complete 3-partite 3-graph $K_{4,4,5}$ as a subgraph, and the oriented matroid of any 13-point configuration in the plane forces a rank-3 circuit whose convex hull has area at most $1/72$."}
